localizedValues.name: S1-Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
the kitchen shelter includes four picnic tables, a barbecue grill and fire pit. Water is available nearby. Shelter cleanup is required by users prior to departing.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
This site is the smaller group camp and is approximately 300 feet from the parking area. It has three walk-in sites, one of which is an adirondack (three-sided shelter with eight bunks). There are three parking spaces at this site. All overflow parking must park in day use area.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: G3
localizedValues.description:
This Group Camp is located - on campground entrance road. There is one 30 amp electrical outlet. Water tap is nearby.
